Method of Attack: Cryptojacking via Docker containers delivering a worm that spreads through unsecured Docker engines, deploying mining containers and executing scripts to control mining activity and propagation
Impacted Systems: Docker hosts with unsecured Docker engine
Attack Vector: Exposed insecure Docker services accessible via public web
Indicators of Compromise: More than 2,000 IP addresses of vulnerable hosts retrieved from Graboid's C2 server
Docker images 'pocosow/centos' and 'gakeaws/nginx' downloaded thousands of times
Scripts live.sh, worm.sh, cleanxmr.sh, xmr.sh executed from C2
